description: LINK-OPEN and LINK-META with the source replaced by a non-database file at the same path (a source in this probe's own work directory, so the link resolves to it): the link host is built and read once; the source file is overwritten with text bytes; the host is reopened and TableDefs are enumerated (Name, Attributes, Connect, SourceTableName), Fields of LK read, then OpenRecordset on LK, then RefreshLink; the file is then overwritten with zero bytes and the open repeated. Asks which call first demands the source and what each reports.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
